scripts.build: node scripts/clean-public.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-achievements.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:standards
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run typecheck
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build:all && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:site: npm run check && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:site
scripts.deploy:standards: npm run build:standards && firebase deploy --only hosting:standards
